changes.old: A post hoc 12-month update of IMbrave150 giving median overall survival of 19.2 against 13.4 months (HR 0.66) and progression-free survival of 6.9 against 4.3 months, with an objective response rate of 30 percent and 8 percent complete responses. The p values are labelled descriptive because no alpha was allocated, the median survival exceeds the median follow-up, and the one subgroup without benefit is non-viral disease (HR for death 1.05, 95% CI 0.68 to 1.63), which is the commonest aetiology in Western practice.
changes.new: A post hoc 12-month update of IMbrave150 giving median overall survival of 19.2 against 13.4 months (HR 0.66) and progression-free survival of 6.9 against 4.3 months, with an objective response rate of 30 percent and 8 percent complete responses. The p values are labelled descriptive because no alpha was allocated, the median survival exceeds the median follow-up, and the exploratory non-viral subgroup estimate was imprecise (HR for death 1.05, 95% CI 0.68 to 1.63), so it does not establish absence of benefit or justify aetiology-based exclusion.
